How rynk works

Growth on autopilot.

Rynk is an automated growth system for your business. It audits your site, plans every fix worth making, ships the changes directly to your CMS and channels, and monitors what changes as search evolves - so you rank higher on Google and get cited more by AI engines, without ever touching an SEO tool.

What you get

The outcomes, up front.

Higher rankings

More of your pages on page one for the keywords your customers actually search.

More AI citations

The trust signals ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overview look for, continuously built.

Fixes shipped for you

Rynk ships meta, schema, pages, links, images, and code changes directly to your site.

Continuous optimization

SERPs shift weekly. Rynk re-audits, re-plans, and re-ships in the background.

Zero tools to learn

You don't touch Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, WordPress, or GitHub. Rynk does the work.

One dashboard

Every action, every channel, every result - in one place. No stack. No sprawl.

Under the hood

Built around four jobs.

Rynk analyzes what's there, generates every change it would make, publishes the result, and monitors what happens next. Each capability below is a real piece of the pipeline running today.

1

Analyze

Crawl, score, and benchmark - Rynk understands the site as deeply as a human auditor.

Full site crawl

Renders every page with a real browser, captures titles, metadata, schema, H1s, body, and internal links.

Performance scoring

PageSpeed Insights per template - TBT, LCP, CLS, render-blocking resources, image weight.

SERP + AI Overview

Every seed keyword checked: top-ranking URLs, People-Also-Ask, AI Overview citations, featured snippets.

Keyword + DA metrics

Volume, difficulty, CPC for every keyword. Domain Authority for you and your competitors.

Onsite and offsite EEAT

Policy pages, author bylines, NAP consistency, certifications, third-party profiles (G2, Crunchbase, Clutch).

Cannibalization detection

URL clusters competing for the same keyword, with a canonical recommendation per cluster.

2

Generate

Eleven generators produce every change rynk plans - typed, validated, traceable.

CMS work

Meta rewrites, schema injection, 301 redirects, internal links, NAP blocks - all produced as structured actions ready to ship.

Full pages

Pillar + spoke pages with titles, meta descriptions, outline, and optional fully-written body. Each linked to its schema and image actions.

Images

Hero images, inline diagrams, social card thumbnails - prompt + dimensions + alt text, generated at publish time.

Outreach drafts

Guest pitches, press, backlink requests - full subject and body, staggered send dates, ready to personalize.

Brand posts

LinkedIn thought-leadership, Reddit discussions, Threads short takes - drafted in your brand's voice with a clear rationale per post.

Documents + PRs

Whitepapers + sales decks for distribution. GitHub PR drafts for code-level fixes when you have a repo.

3

Publish

Every action is dispatched to the right service - WordPress, GitHub, image generation, document rendering.

WordPress adapter

Pushes meta, schema, redirects, pages, and authors via the WP REST API. Detects which SEO plugin (Yoast / RankMath / SEOPress) is installed.

Image pipeline

Generates each image action via the configured provider and attaches the results to the right post automatically.

Document rendering

Markdown to PDF / PPTX, distributed to SlideShare, Scribd, and Issuu for wider indexing.

GitHub PRs

Opens draft pull requests for code-level fixes - proper branch naming, full description, test plan.

Approval gating

Every action carries a risk score and an automatable flag. Humans approve riskier actions before they fire.

Status tracking

Every action records its lifecycle: pending, approved, applied, done. Failed actions retry without re-planning.

4

Monitor

Search shifts every week. Rynk watches the results and feeds what changed back into the plan.

Weekly SERP re-crawls

The top results for every target keyword re-pulled weekly - new entrants, dropped competitors, position shifts.

Rank tracking

Where you stand for every keyword, tracked over time - on Google and in AI engines.

Competitor deltas

When a new competitor takes over a top spot, rynk catches it and re-plans that keyword automatically.

Traffic ground truth

Search Console impressions and clicks plus Analytics sessions and conversions, pulled weekly so results tie back to real traffic.

Backlink watch

New and lost backlinks tracked over time - the authority signals behind your rankings.

Weekly digest

One summary per week: what moved, what rynk shipped in response, and what's next.

Ready to plug rynk in?

Setup takes five minutes. After that, rynk runs on its own.
